comment: The panel draws the maker's normalling arrow beside the frequency input column, as Asset, Ceres, Fuji, Atlas and Sena all do, but Halo's process reads those inputs with a plain getVoltage and never carries a value forward (src/Halo.cpp:74-75). The frequency input line names that conflict. The logic is done on the analogue waveforms rather than on gates: AND is the sample-by-sample minimum, OR the maximum, XOR the maximum less the minimum, and MIX their average, so all four outputs are continuous voltages rather than gates. sumRange on the frequency inputs is written as a voltage range because the field takes only those four spellings; the quantity clamped is the 0-to-1 knob position. The frequency ranges are literals: 0.00875Hz to 8.75Hz in LO and 0.05Hz to 87.5Hz in HI.
